generator._comment: archive_dir keeps a dated copy of every generated original; archive_keep_days 0 keeps them all. This is the only copy on the machine that made the picture: the working files are overwritten each run, Home Assistant prunes its own after keep_days, and an archive server can be down for weeks unnoticed. codex_model and codex_reasoning_effort still work here for older configs, but the provider block supersedes them.

publish._comment: The long-lived access token is read from FOREDOGS_HA_TOKEN so it never lands in this file. Store it in ~/.config/foredogs/ha_token.

immich._comment: Optional. Leave album_id empty to skip archiving. The API key is read from FOREDOGS_IMMICH_KEY, stored in ~/.config/foredogs/immich_key.

provider._comment: kind: 'codex' drives the codex CLI (no API key here, whatever the CLI is logged into answers). 'openai' talks to any OpenAI-compatible endpoint: OpenAI, Google, LiteLLM, OpenRouter, Ollama, a local proxy. Aliases: openai-compatible, gemini, litellm, ollama.
provider._comment_openai: The keys below apply to kind 'openai' only. The API key is never stored here: api_key_env names the environment variable to read it from.
